body:
kanban.go/kanban_page.go/main.go's /admin/kanban route were already fully built (3-column backlog/priority/cruise board, drag-and-drop) but had zero nav entry point anywhere in IDUNA. Added one nav link in the shared admin.go template, no layout rework, per founder's own 'shove it in there' direction. Verified: go build + GOWORK=off go build both clean, go test ./internal/http/handlers/... passes, live iduna.service rebuilt/restarted, curl /admin/kanban -> 401 (route+middleware confirmed live, not 404), binary strings-checked for the new nav text. Commit 7aba7a7.
